Any other difference refuses.

rule.room: a target has room iff v5 holds on at most 2 of its 3 seeds; with 3 of 3 it cannot clear (cannot_clear). Decided from the envelope alone, before the arm's rows are read. If exactly one target has no room it is read as a guard instead (the arm must hold on 3 of 3 seeds too) and the decision rests on the other target; if neither has room the arm does not launch (launch_condition), and any rows that exist anyway read 'refused'.
rule.targets_form: seed_holds. A seed holds a category iff its count is at least half: 2 * n >= n_total (>= 30/60, the F2 bar of campaign/v4-noul-v3b-preregistered.json). A target clears iff all three arm seeds hold AND the arm holds on strictly more seeds than v5's envelope does.

detail.then: no reading; the human decides from the rows
